text: DEFONEOS — DWP Carer's Allowance AI Deep-Dive Pack EU AI Act Article 50 live 2 Aug 2026 — C2PA passport ready | Get yours → Home Master GovBench Index Sitemap DEFONEOS × DWP × CARER'S ALLOWANCE DWP Carer's Allowance AI Deep-Dive Pack Sovereign AI governance of UK DWP Carer's Allowance claims, caring hours verification, earnings rules, overlapping benefits, and carer support. 12 entry points × 8 transformation priorities × 6 MCPs. Audit-grade. Signed. UK-sovereign. 12 Entry Points 8 Transformation Priorities 6 MCP Servers 7 Backbone Orgs 📋 12 Entry Points Eligibility Carer's Allowance Eligibility AI 35+ hours/week caring. Earnings threshold (£151/week after deductions). Cared-for person on qualifying disability benefit. Not in full-time education. Resident in UK. Age 16+ verification. Caring Hours Caring Hours Verification AI Weekly hours logging. Multiple carer split. Overnight care assessment. Caring pattern analysis. Evidence collection. Carer statement validation. Earnings Rules Earnings Threshold AI Net earnings calculation. Permitted work allowance. Self-employment income. Expense deductions. HMRC data integration. Overpayment prevention. Overlapping Benefits Overlapping Benefit Prevention AI State Pension overlap. ESA overlap. Maternity Allowance overlap. Training Allowance overlap. Best-rate recommendation. Underpayment detection. Carer Premium Carer Premium & Addition AI Carer premium in HB/CTB. SDP interaction. UC carer element. Pension Credit addition. Passport benefit routing. Income maximisation. Breaks in Caring Breaks & Respite AI 12-week break rule. Hospital admission. Residential care. Holiday respite. Temporary breaks. Re-entitlement after break. Young Carers Young Carer Support AI Under-18 eligibility. Education impact assessment. Safeguarding integration. Transition at 16. Mental health support. Local authority referral. Carer Wellbeing Carer Wellbeing & Support AI Carer's assessment integration. Respite care routing. Mental health signposting. Financial wellbeing. Employment support. Social isolation detection. Fraud & Error Carer's Allowance Counter-Fraud AI Earnings verification. Caring hours validation. Cross-benefit checking. Duplicate claim detection. HMRC data matching. Overpayment recovery. Appeals Carer's Allowance Appeals AI MR merit assessment. Evidence compilation. Tribunal preparation. Decision reversal tracking. Outcome analytics. Systemic error identification. Data Carer's Allowance Data Governance AI Caseload forecasting. Take-up rate monitoring. Cared-for benefit linking. Regional disparity analysis. Processing time analytics. Privacy compliance. Parliamentary Carer's Allowance Parliamentary AI Statistics publication. Carer poverty impact. Policy change modelling. Select Committee evidence. Carer strategy reporting. Reform metrics. ⚡ 8 Transformation Priorities 1. Take-Up Maximisation Identify 1.3M+ unpaid carers not claiming. Community outreach. Simplified application. Proxy claims for elderly. Target 100% take-up. 2. Earnings Flexibility Modernise earnings threshold. Real-time HMRC integration. Permitted work reform. Self-employment fair treatment. Gig economy compatibility. 3. Digital Inclusion Telephone-first for carers. Paper forms maintained. Trusted person proxy. Accessible formats. No digital-only barriers. 4. Young Carer Protection Safeguarding-first approach. Education maintenance. Mental health priority. Transition support at 16. Local authority integration. 5. Carer Wellbeing Integration NHS carer pathway linking. Respite care auto-referral. Mental health screening. Social isolation detection. Employment support. 6. Overlapping Benefit Clarity Clear guidance on overlaps. Best-rate auto-recommendation. No gaps in support. Pension-age carer protection. UC transition support. 7. Fraud Without Harassment Evidence-based risk scoring. No blanket investigations. Proportionate checks. Dignity-first compliance. Carer-friendly processes. 8. Parliamentary Transparency Real-time carer dashbo
